    - paragraph
    - heading "What Personal Information About Customers Does Amazon Collect?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: We collect your personal information in order to provide and continually improve our products and services.
    - paragraph: "Here are the types of personal information we collect:"
    - paragraph
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Information You Give Us:"
        - text: We receive and store any information you provide in relation to Amazon Services. You can choose not to provide certain information, but then you might not be able to take advantage of many of our Amazon Services.
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Automatic Information:"
        - text: We automatically collect and store certain types of information about your use of Amazon Services, including information about your interaction with products, content, and services available through Amazon Services. Like many websites, we use "cookies" and other unique identifiers, and we obtain certain types of information when your web browser or device accesses Amazon Services and other content served by or on behalf of Amazon on other websites. Our physical stores may use cameras, computer vision, sensors, and other technology to gather information about your activity in the store, such as the products and services you interact with.
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Information from Other Sources:"
        - text: We might receive information about you from other sources. For example, our carriers may provide us with updated delivery and address information, which we use to keep our records current and make delivery of your future purchases easier.
    - paragraph
    - paragraph:
      - text: See
      - link "examples of information we collect or receive":
        - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GX7NJQ4ZB8MHFRNJ&ref_=footer_privacy#GUID-8966E75F-9B92-4A2B-BFD5-967D57513A40__SECTION_87C837F9CCD84769B4AE2BEB14AF4F01
      - text: .
    - heading "For What Purposes Does Amazon Use Your Personal Information?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We use your personal information to operate, provide, develop, and improve the products and services that we offer our customers. These purposes include:"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Purchase and delivery of products and services.
        - text: We use your personal information to take and handle orders, deliver products and services, process payments, and communicate with you about orders, products and services, and promotional offers.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Provide, troubleshoot, and improve Amazon Services.
        - text: We use your personal information to provide functionality, analyze performance, fix errors, and improve the usability and effectiveness of the Amazon Services. In so doing, we use machine learning and artificial intelligence to support and enhance the customer experience across our products and services. This includes using data to develop or deploy our generative AI models and services. See our
        - link "Generative AI Development Disclosure":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=TmGoGN3UbFaQ1CAph7
        - text: for more information.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Recommendations and personalization.
        - text: We use your personal information to recommend features, products, and services that might be of interest to you, identify your preferences, and personalize your experience with Amazon Services.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Provide voice, image and camera services.
        - text: When you use our voice, image and camera services, we use your voice input, images, videos, and other personal information to respond to your requests, provide the requested service to you, and improve our services. You can read more about
        - link "Alexa, Echo Devices, and Your Privacy":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GVP69FUJ48X9DK8V
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - strong: Comply with legal obligations.
        - text: In certain cases, we collect and use your personal information to comply with laws. For instance, we collect from sellers information regarding place of establishment and bank account information for identity verification and other purposes.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Communicate with you.
        - text: We use your personal information to communicate with you in relation to Amazon Services via different channels (for example, by phone, email or chat).
      - listitem:
        - strong: Advertising.
        - text: We use your personal information to display interest-based ads for features, products, and services that might be of interest to you. We do not use information that personally identifies you to display interest-based ads. To learn more, please read our
        - link "Interest-Based Ads":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/ibanotice
        - text: notice.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Fraud Prevention and Credit Risks.
        - text: We use personal information to prevent and detect fraud and abuse in order to protect the security of our customers, Amazon, and others. We may also use scoring methods to assess and manage credit risks.
    - heading "What About Cookies and Other Identifiers?" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: To enable our systems to recognize your browser or device and to provide and improve Amazon Services, we use cookies and other identifiers. For more information about cookies and how we use them, please read our
      - link "Cookies Notice":
        - /url: https://www.amazon.com/cookies
      - text: .
    - heading "Does Amazon Share Your Personal Information?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Information about our customers is an important part of our business, and we are not in the business of selling our customers' personal information to others. We share customers' personal information only as described below and with subsidiaries Amazon.com, Inc. controls that either are subject to this Privacy Notice or follow practices at least as protective as those described in this Privacy Notice.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Transactions involving Third Parties:"
        - text: We make available to you services, products, applications, or skills provided by third parties for use on or through Amazon Services. For example, you can order products from third parties through our stores, download applications from third-party application providers from our App Store, and enable third-party skills through our Alexa services. We also offer services or sell product lines jointly with third-party businesses, such as co-branded credit cards. You can tell when a third party is involved in your transactions, and we share customers' personal information related to those transactions with that third party.
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Third-Party Service Providers:"
        - text: We employ other companies and individuals to perform functions on our behalf. Examples include fulfilling orders for products or services, delivering packages, sending postal mail and email, removing repetitive information from customer lists, analyzing data, providing marketing assistance, providing search results and links (including paid listings and links), processing payments, transmitting content, scoring, assessing and managing credit risk, and providing customer service. These third-party service providers have access to personal information needed to perform their functions, but may not use it for other purposes.
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Business Transfers:"
        - text: As we continue to develop our business, we might sell or buy other businesses or services. In such transactions, customer information generally is one of the transferred business assets but remains subject to the promises made in any pre-existing Privacy Notice (unless, of course, the customer consents otherwise). Also, in the unlikely event that Amazon.com, Inc. or substantially all of its assets are acquired, customer information will of course be one of the transferred assets.
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Protection of Amazon and Others:"
        - text: We release account and other personal information when we believe release is appropriate to comply with the law; enforce or apply our
        - link "Conditions of Use":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GLSBYFE9MGKKQXXM
        - text: and other agreements; or protect the rights, property, or safety of Amazon, our users, or others. This includes exchanging information with other companies and organizations for fraud protection and credit risk reduction.
    - paragraph: Other than as set out above, you will receive notice when personal information about you might be shared with third parties, and you will have an opportunity to choose not to share the information.
    - heading "How Secure Is Information About Me?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: We design our systems with your security and privacy in mind.
    - list:
      - listitem: We work to protect the security of your personal information during transmission by using encryption protocols and software.
      - listitem: We follow the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) when handling credit card data.
      - listitem: We maintain physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards in connection with the collection, storage, and disclosure of customer personal information. Our security procedures mean that we may ask to verify your identity before we disclose personal information to you.
      - listitem:
        - text: Our devices offer security features to protect them against unauthorized access and loss of data. You can control these features and configure them based on your needs. Learn more about how to manage the security settings of your device at
        - link "Digital Services and Device Support":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=200127470
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - text: It is important for you to protect against unauthorized access to your password and to your computers, devices, and applications. We recommend using a unique password for your Amazon account that is not used for other online accounts. Consider enhancing your security by following the guidance at our
        - link "Your Security":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GYFK65F3SL8ABWQZ
        - text: page.
      - listitem:
        - text: Be sure to sign off when finished using a shared computer. Read more information on
        - link "Signing Out of Your Amazon Account":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GQL359FK7DM8294C
        - text: .
    - heading "What About Advertising?" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Third-Party Advertisers and Links to Other Websites:"
        - text: Amazon Services may include third-party advertising and links to other websites and apps. Third-party advertising partners may collect information about you when you interact with their content, advertising, and services. For more information about third-party advertising at Amazon, including interest-based ads, please read our
        - link "Interest-Based Ads":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/ibanotice
        - text: notice. To adjust your advertising preferences, please visit
        - link "Your Ads Privacy Choices":
          - /url: https://www.amazon.com/privacyprefs?ref_=footer_iba
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - strong: "Use of Third-Party Advertising Services:"
        - text: We provide ad companies with information that allows them to serve you with more useful and relevant Amazon ads and to measure their effectiveness. We never share your name or other information that directly identifies you when we do this. Instead, we use an advertising identifier like a cookie, a device identifier, or a code derived from applying irreversible cryptography to other information like an email address. For example, if you have already downloaded one of our apps, we will share your advertising identifier and data about that event so that you will not be served an ad to download the app again. While we do not share your specific shopping actions like purchases, product views, or searches with ad companies, we may share an advertising identifier and an estimate of the value of the ads they show you on our behalf so they can serve you with more effective Amazon ads. Some ad companies also use this information to serve you relevant ads from other advertisers. You can learn more about how to opt-out of personalized advertising (such as cross-context behavioral advertising) by visiting
        - link "Your Ads Privacy Choices":

        - link "Your Profile":

    - paragraph
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Automatic Information
    - paragraph: "Examples of the information we collect and analyze include:"
    - list:
      - listitem: the internet protocol (IP) address used to connect your computer to the internet;
      - listitem: login, email address, and password;
      - listitem: the location of your device or computer;
      - listitem: content interaction information, such as content downloads, streams, and playback details, including duration and number of simultaneous streams and downloads, and network details for streaming and download quality, including information about your internet service provider;
      - listitem: device metrics such as when a device is in use, application usage, connectivity data, and any errors or event failures;
      - listitem: Amazon Services metrics (for example, the occurrences of technical errors, your interactions with service features and content, your settings preferences and backup information, location of your device running an application, information about uploaded images and files such as the file name, dates, times and location of your images);
      - listitem: version and time zone settings;
      - listitem:
        - text: purchase and content use history, which we sometimes aggregate with similar information from other customers to create features like
        - link "Top Sellers":

        - text: ;
      - listitem: the full Uniform Resource Locator (URL) clickstream to, through, and from our websites, including date and time; products and content you viewed or searched for; page response times, download errors, length of visits to certain pages, and page interaction information (such as scrolling, clicks, and mouse-overs);
      - listitem: phone numbers used to call our customer service number; and
      - listitem: images or videos when you shop in our stores, or stores using Amazon Services.
    - paragraph: We may also use device identifiers, cookies, and other technologies on devices, applications, and our web pages to collect browsing, usage, or other technical information.

        - text: );

      - listitem: content that you recently viewed;
      - listitem: voice recordings associated with your account;
      - listitem: Your Profile (including your product Reviews, Recommendations, Reminders and personal profile);

        - text: If you are a seller, you can access your account and other information, and adjust your communications preferences, by updating your account in

        - text: .
